name: Patagonia Wilderness
tagline: The End of the World, Where Mountains Meet the Sea
intro: Patagonia is one of the last truly wild places on earth — a vast, dramatic landscape of jagged granite peaks, ancient glaciers, turquoise lakes, and windswept steppes stretching across the southern tip of South America. It is a land of extremes, where Andean condors soar and pumas stalk the high pampa.

signatureExperiences.title: Torres del Paine Circuit
signatureExperiences.description: The legendary W-Trek and full circuit traverse some of the most dramatic mountain scenery on earth, past the iconic granite towers.

signatureExperiences.title: Glacier Trekking
signatureExperiences.description: Walk on the ancient ice of Grey Glacier or Perito Moreno with expert crampons and guides, surrounded by electric-blue seracs.

signatureExperiences.title: Condor Spotting
signatureExperiences.description: The Andean condor, with a wingspan of over 3 metres, is a regular presence in Patagonia's thermals. Learn to identify individuals.

signatureExperiences.title: Estancia Life
signatureExperiences.description: Experience traditional Patagonian ranch life on a private estancia — gaucho horsemanship, asado dinners, and stargazing under pristine skies.

wildlifeHighlights.notes: Often seen soaring on thermals above the park's higher elevations, particularly near Lago Nordenskjöld.
Chilean Patagonia has seen remarkable puma habituation in recent years; sightings are increasingly reliable with expert guides.
This critically endangered South Andean deer appears on Chile's coat of arms and is occasionally spotted in remote valleys.

lodging.name: EcoCamp Patagonia
lodging.description: The world's first geodesic hotel, located inside Torres del Paine with 360-degree views of the iconic towers.

lodging.name: Awasi Patagonia
lodging.description: Individual villas with dedicated guides and private 4x4 vehicles, on a private lakeside estate near Torres del Paine.

bestTimeToVisit: October–April (Austral summer) for trekking; August–September for puma sightings

meta.title: Patagonia Wilderness Expeditions | Adventure International
meta.description: Trek through the dramatic wilderness of Chilean and Argentine Patagonia. Luxury trekking expeditions with Adventure International.
